glosses: to doodle (to draw or scribble aimlessly)
to scribble on (cover with messy writing)
Écrire, dessiner ou peindre quelque chose d’une manière confuse et informe.

examples.text: Gribouiller, faire mes pages, c'étaient là de saines formules, m'épargnant toute exaltation.
Le téléphone sonna trois fois et Max parla longuement, en fumant. Il gribouillait sur une feuille de papier près de l'appareil.
Il plia la feuille, l'introduisit dans une enveloppe sur laquelle il gribouilla le nom et l'adresse de son ami. Il examina quelques secondes la suscription difficilement lisible […].
On découvre des acteurs qui signent des tribunes sans réfléchir, comme ils gribouillent des autographes avant de monter les marches du Festival de Cannes, […].

glosses: etwas in kurzer Zeit und mit schlechter Qualität schreiben, malen oder zeichnen

examples.text: Was hast du denn auf dieses Blatt gekritzelt?
Er kritzelte eine Nachricht an seine Tür.
„Sie kritzelten auf ihre Schiefertafeln in der Schule die Umrisse von Flugzeugen, die Stukas oder Messerschmitt hießen.“

glosses: To write or draw carelessly and in a hurry.

examples.text: I suddenly remembered I needed to buy bleach, so scribbled it down on my shopping list.

glosses: To write badly; to work as an inferior author or journalist.
Careless, hasty writing, doodle or drawing
To card or tease (wool) coarsely; to run through a scribbler.
A fool, a simpleton, a mindless person.

examples.text:
Mrs. Sneak. Why doodle! jackanapes! harkee, who am I?
Sneak. Come, don't go to call names: am I? vhy my vife, and I am your master.

Perceval. Weep on! weep on! thou flouted loon,
Weep on! weep on! thou gowky doodle!

Courtier, it was thine to bow —
 Great Arthur he, and Doodle thou!
His doodle hung as limp as last month's celery.

Her favorite had been when she'd convinced the lascivious guards that Dinah's red hair meant she was a witch, and if they molested her, their doodles would shrivel up between their legs and fall off. Daisy had assured her that no man would risk losing his doodle.

All of Dwight's parts wandered, especially his doodle. He had the wandering-est doodle in three states. His doodle had its own set of legs. His doodle was hardly at home. Heck, according to rumor Dwight Farris's doodle was hardly ever in his pants.
The bored student doodled a submarine in his notebook.

glosses: To engage in something non-seriously; fiddle.

examples.text: I've been expecting women's music finally to discover New Wave and technopop, and this album is the evidence that someone has been peaking ^([sic]) at music videos and doodling around with sythesizers.

For quite a long time now (at least the 1990s) people have been doodling with the idea of separating space and time again and perhaps endowing them with some properties currently not assigned to them.
